LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.7 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Fluency By the
Topic 2.8: Guided Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading, part of Reading 2.7 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Fluency By the in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can one effectively read texts for comprehension?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read out vocabulary related to weather conditions from flashcards (e.g.热、冷、暖、凉、晴、刮风、 多云 etc.),

2. work jointly to write simple sentences with the acquired vocabulary and read them aloud,

3. read out phrases and sentences related to weather conditions with appropriate expressions (e.g. 今天很 冷,下午不热,星期一会刮风),

4. rearrange jumbled up sentences and read them out with peers,

5. read and answer questions on weather conditions with peers in turns (e.g. 明天天气怎么样? 明天是 多云),

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read out vocabulary related to weather conditions from flashcards (e.g.热、冷、暖、凉、晴、刮风、 多云 etc.),
2. work jointly to write simple sentences with the acquired vocabulary and read them aloud,
3. read out phrases and sentences related to weather conditions with appropriate expressions (e.g. 今天很 冷,下午不热,星期一会刮风),
4. rearrange jumbled up sentences and read them out with peers,
5. read and answer questions on weather conditions with peers in turns (e.g. 明天天气怎么样? 明天是 多云),

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner develops relationships with peers as they share what they have learnt while comparing weather

conditions in different places using 比.

Values:
Respect: The learner patiently waits for their turn to read and answer questions related to weather conditions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental education: This is promoted as the learner interacts with texts on descriptions of weather conditions in their

environment.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of weather conditions to their learning in Social Studies.
